visual_identity.core_identity: A predatory centipede defined by a long segmented body, one pair of legs per visible trunk segment, antennae, and strong front poison claws.
visual_identity.silhouette: Long flexible segmented body forming an S-curve or coil, with many evenly spaced legs creating a saw-tooth edge.
visual_identity.head_features: Small armored head with simple antennae and strong curved forcipule-like poison claws.
visual_identity.body_shape: Many repeated trunk segments, each bearing one visible pair of legs, tapering toward the rear.
visual_identity.limb_structure: One pair of walking legs per visible trunk segment plus front poison claws; never spider-like eight-leg anatomy.
visual_identity.surface: Simple armored segment plates with minimal texture.

accuracy_checks: body is not mistaken for snake

known_failure_modes.symptom: legs disappear and body reads as snake
known_failure_modes.correction: restore repeated leg pairs along visible segments
restore long segmented trunk with many paired legs

known_failure_modes.symptom: segments and legs become tiny repetitive clutter
known_failure_modes.correction: simplify visible segments and keep leg rhythm large enough to color

scene_identity.size_impression: Oversized arthropod long enough to coil around a niche or object while remaining smaller than major dungeon architecture.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Body fully supported along floor, wall, bone pile, or other surface with repeated legs contacting the substrate.
behavior_style: investigating a large bone or object
environment_fit: rock or debris zones with clear crawling surfaces
